title: CRUD, Aggregates and Joins
description: Changing and querying rows: INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE, repeatable seed data, filtering and sorting, NULL handling with COALESCE and CASE, aggregate functions, GROUP BY with HAVING, inner and left joins, anti-joins and self-joins.
sourceCoverageNotes: Second-mate grouping decision, not syllabus: calendar days F20 (/tracks/0/weeks/3/days/4, rows 0-4) and F21 (/tracks/0/weeks/4/days/0, rows 0-2), one page per row (relation exact). F20 and F21 stay together because F20 'Aggregate functions' leads directly into F21 'GROUP BY and HAVING'.

Planned module coding lab (lab plan in evidence/sql-jdbc-foundations/intake.md): CRUD, seed, filter, NULL, aggregate, grouping and join queries tested with mvn -q -o test against a lab-created database on the learner-local PostgreSQL server through pgJDBC, with the seed script's \copy run through real psql (no container); authored with its lab.json in the crud-aggregates-and-joins module PR, so moduleLabs stays empty until the lab exists.
